name: Tear of Elune mount keeps the rider's own model (#11658)
contract: Tear of Elune 979870 casts the ground variants 979871 and 979872. Their effects are MOUNTED with creature 100226,
a mounted speed aura and SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM into creature 100225, which has no creature_template; core falls back
to the pig display 16358. No other mount wrapper transforms the rider. Mounting must set the mount display 48527
from creature_template_model 100226 and leave the rider's display id unchanged.

steps.label: The rider sits on the Tear of Elune mount model
The rider keeps their own display instead of the pig fallback
